data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing pytest tests for the NEW proximity-matching behavior of _suppress_defended_findings. Must fail before T4 implementation task.

## File
tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py (new)

## Test Cases (all must fail before T4)
1. test_proximity_cited_lines_suppress_overlap: defense has cited_lines=['runner.py:42'], finding has cited_lines=['runner.py:43'] (within ±5) → finding's severity downgraded to 'suggestion'
2. test_proximity_cited_lines_no_suppress_outside_window: defense cited_lines=['runner.py:42'], finding cited_lines=['runner.py:55'] (diff=13, >5) → severity unchanged
3. test_legacy_fallback_description_prefix_when_no_cited_lines: defense has no cited_lines field, description matches → falls back to description[:80] suppression (tests that existing path still works)
4. test_carve_out_no_suppress_when_diff_touches_region: defense has cited_lines + story_branch_base_sha/story_branch_tip_sha, mock _inter_cycle_diff_modified_region returns True → NOT suppressed despite proximity overlap
5. test_carve_out_suppression_when_diff_clean: same setup, mock returns False → proximity suppression fires

## Acceptance
All 5 tests exist in test_suppress_proximity.py, test file is collected by pytest, all 5 currently FAIL (AttributeError or assertion error) since runner.py doesn't yet use proximity.py

## Note
Do NOT re-implement proximity parsing — use from dso_ci_review.proximity import compute_proximity_overlap (module is already GREEN).
SHA field names for carve-out: story_branch_base_sha / story_branch_tip_sha (from review-defenses.md contract).
